title: Kissed Mediterranean White Cabbage Skewers
description: A romantic Mediterranean dish featuring white cabbage, miso-marinate, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, served in a copper mug.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the white cabbage pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the miso marinade.
Thread the marinated cabbage pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers in a copper mug and enjoy.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
